reason: Continue exact registered measurements after the chat executor disconnected; historical completed artifacts remain immutable.
measurement_rule: Each cohort uses its own VM. Paired modes stay sequential. Cohorts, budgets, tokenizers, sources, models and repetitions remain unchanged. Record platform/packages per cohort; never pool latencies across hosts.
publication: Each job stages only explicit public reports, checkpoints and completion/failure markers, then pushes a unique validation result branch with its repository-scoped Actions token. Raw datasets, prompts, weights and credentials are excluded. Root review integrates results into main.
failures: A failed or interrupted stage is not complete. No automatic replay of ambiguous model requests. Original checkpoints/results stay immutable.
prerequisite: Hosted runners and verified data/model downloads are infrastructure changes, not a new retrieval policy.
